title: Don't Put Everything in One Basket
tagline: A colleague raves about one company. How do you spread — or not?

character.name: Imran
character.role: software tester with simulated ₹50,000 to practise with

b1_choose.title: A colleague's favourite
b1_choose.narrative: Imran has a simulated ₹50,000 to practise with. A colleague says Kaveri Solar Ltd (fictional) “can't fail”. Four fictional options are available: Kaveri Solar, Gomti Foods, Narmada Steel and Sutlej Bank, plus Brahmaputra Solar (another solar company). Nothing here is a recommendation about any real asset.

messages: Kaveri Solar is up 60% this year. It can't fail! Put it all in.

evidence.label: “It can't fail”
evidence.why: No company or sector is immune to bad events. Certainty is a signal to examine, not to relax.

evidence.label: “Up 60% this year”
evidence.text: A past gain used as the reason.
evidence.why: Past gains do not tell you about the future and can make a risk look safer than it is.

evidence.label: Everything would depend on one company
evidence.why: This is concentration risk: one bad event can hit all of your money at once.

evidence.label: Solar depends partly on government policy
evidence.text: Policy changes can move a whole sector.
evidence.why: Companies in the same sector can fall together — owning two similar companies is not the same as spreading across different areas.

actions.label: All ₹50,000 in Kaveri Solar — Vikas is confident
actions.consequence: You put everything into one company.

actions.label: Split between Kaveri Solar and Brahmaputra Solar — that's diversified
actions.consequence: You hold two companies from the same sector.

actions.label: Split equally across four different fictional assets
actions.consequence: You spread the money across four unrelated areas.

actions.label: Keep ₹10,000 aside as an emergency cushion and split the rest across the four
actions.consequence: You keep a cushion and spread the rest.
actions.simple_label: Keep a cushion, split the rest

b1_choose.reasoning_prompt: Why did you choose this split?

b2_all.title: The policy shock
b2_all.narrative: A fictional government delays a solar subsidy. Kaveri Solar falls 35% and Brahmaputra Solar falls 32%; Gomti Foods +2%, Narmada Steel −3%, Sutlej Bank +1%. Everything was in one company. Your simulated ₹50,000 is now about ₹32,500 (−₹17,500).

messages: SOLAR SHOCK: subsidy delayed. Sector falls sharply.

evidence.label: How much of your money depended on solar?
evidence.text: Compare how much each choice lost to the same event.
evidence.why: The same event hurts very differently depending on how concentrated the money was.

evidence.label: “It will bounce back” — said with full certainty
evidence.text: Someone is sure about the future.
evidence.why: Nobody knows. Certainty about recovery is as unreliable as certainty about collapse.

actions.label: Review: how much of my money depended on one company or sector?
actions.consequence: You list each holding and how it behaved. The picture is clearer.

actions.label: Put the rest into the same company to win it back faster
actions.consequence: You increase the concentration right after seeing its effect.

actions.label: Do nothing; it's temporary, I'm sure
actions.consequence: You rely on a feeling of certainty rather than a plan.

b2_all.reasoning_prompt: What does this result tell you about how you chose?

b3_broad.title: A different kind of fall
b3_broad.narrative: A few weeks later a broad downturn hits the whole fictional market: all four companies fall about 12% together, whatever sector they are in. Cash (if any) stays flat.

evidence.label: Different assets fell together
evidence.text: This time sector did not matter.
evidence.why: Diversification reduces concentration risk, but market-wide risk remains. It is a seatbelt, not an invincibility suit.

evidence.label: “Diversification doesn't work”
evidence.why: One event where assets fell together does not cancel the earlier lesson; both lessons are true.

actions.label: Both are true: spreading helps with one-company risk; it can't remove market-wide risk, so my plan, time horizon and cushion still matter
actions.consequence: You hold two ideas at once, which is what a resilient plan needs.

actions.label: So spreading is pointless — go back to one company
actions.consequence: You discard a useful tool because it was not magic.

actions.label: I diversified, so I should not have lost anything
actions.consequence: You expected diversification to remove all risk.

b3_broad.reasoning_prompt: What does diversification do, and what can it not do?

t_aware.title: You see both sides
t_aware.narrative: Spreading reduces the damage from one thing going wrong, but cannot remove risk that hits everything. Knowing what a tool does — and does not do — is the point.

outcome.headline: You see both sides
outcome.summary: Spreading reduces the damage from one thing going wrong, but cannot remove risk that hits everything. Knowing what a tool does — and does not do — is the point.

t_overreacted.title: A tool, not magic
t_overreacted.narrative: Diversification did its job in the first shock. One broad fall does not make it useless; it makes it incomplete on its own.

outcome.headline: A tool, not magic
outcome.summary: Diversification did its job in the first shock. One broad fall does not make it useless; it makes it incomplete on its own.

t_overconfident.title: Expecting no risk
t_overconfident.narrative: Diversification is not risk removal. Believing it is can lead people to take on more risk than they can handle.

outcome.headline: Expecting no risk
outcome.summary: Diversification is not risk removal. Believing it is can lead people to take on more risk than they can handle.

t_doubled_down.title: Concentration, again
t_doubled_down.narrative: Putting more into the same place right after seeing the effect of concentration is the loss-recovery trap. A bigger bet is not a faster way back.

outcome.headline: Concentration, again
outcome.summary: Putting more into the same place right after seeing the effect of concentration is the loss-recovery trap. A bigger bet is not a faster way back.

key_points: One company or sector can fall a lot at once. Concentration risk is the share of your money exposed to a single event.
Two similar assets (same sector) are not true diversification.
Diversification reduces — it does not eliminate — risk.
A cushion of easily accessible money is part of a resilient plan.
questions: What share of your money depends on one thing?

micro_lesson.title: The 'what if this one thing fails?' question
micro_lesson.body: For any plan ask: if the biggest piece fell 40%, how much of my total would I lose? If the answer is more than you could handle, the plan is too concentrated.

hinglish.title: Sab Ande Ek Tokri Mein Mat Rakho
hinglish.tagline: Colleague ek company ki tareef karta hai. Aap paisa kaise baantoge — ya nahi?
hinglish.states.b1_choose.title: Colleague ki pasandeeda company
hinglish.states.b1_choose.narrative: Imran ke paas practice ke liye simulated ₹50,000 hain. Ek colleague kehta hai Kaveri Solar Ltd (kaalpanik) “fail ho hi nahi sakti”. Chaar kaalpanik options hain: Kaveri Solar, Gomti Foods, Narmada Steel aur Sutlej Bank, aur Brahmaputra Solar (ek aur solar company). Yahan kisi asli asset ke baare mein koi sifarish nahi.

hinglish.states.b1_choose.evidence.b1_cant.label: “Ye fail nahi ho sakti”
hinglish.states.b1_choose.evidence.b1_cant.why: Koi company ya sector buri ghatnaon se mukt nahi. Pakka vishwas jaanchne ka sanket hai, nishchint hone ka nahi.
hinglish.states.b1_choose.evidence.b1_past.label: “Is saal 60% badhi”
hinglish.states.b1_choose.evidence.b1_past.text: Pichhla faayda wajah ke taur par.
hinglish.states.b1_choose.evidence.b1_past.why: Pichhle faayde bhavishya ke baare mein nahi batate aur risk ko surakshit dikha sakte hain.
hinglish.states.b1_choose.evidence.b1_one.label: Sab kuch ek company par nirbhar hoga
hinglish.states.b1_choose.evidence.b1_one.why: Ye concentration risk hai: ek buri ghatna aapke poore paise par ek saath asar daal sakti hai.
hinglish.states.b1_choose.evidence.b1_sector.labe: Solar kuch had tak sarkari policy par nirbhar hai
hinglish.states.b1_choose.evidence.b1_sector.text: Policy badalne se poora sector hil sakta hai.
hinglish.states.b1_choose.evidence.b1_sector.why: Ek hi sector ki companies ek saath gir sakti hain — do milti-julti companies rakhna alag-alag kshetron mein baantna nahi.
hinglish.states.b1_choose.actions.all_in.label: Poora ₹50,000 Kaveri Solar mein — Vikas ko vishwas hai
hinglish.states.b1_choose.actions.all_in.conseque: Aap sab kuch ek company mein daalte ho.
hinglish.states.b1_choose.actions.two_solar.label: Kaveri Solar aur Brahmaputra Solar mein baant do — ye diversified hai
hinglish.states.b1_choose.actions.two_solar.conse: Aap ek hi sector ki do companies rakhte ho.
hinglish.states.b1_choose.actions.split_four.labe: Chaar alag kaalpanik assets mein barabar baant do
hinglish.states.b1_choose.actions.split_four.cons: Aap paisa chaar alag kshetron mein baantte ho.
hinglish.states.b1_choose.actions.buffer_split.la: ₹10,000 emergency cushion ke liye rakho aur baaki chaar mein baanto
hinglish.states.b1_choose.actions.buffer_split.co: Aap cushion rakhte ho aur baaki baantte ho.
hinglish.states.b1_choose.reasoning_prompt: Aapne ye baantne ka tareeka kyun chuna?
hinglish.states.b2_all.title: Policy ka jhatka
hinglish.states.b2_all.narrative: Ek kaalpanik sarkar solar subsidy rok deti hai. Kaveri Solar 35% aur Brahmaputra Solar 32% girte hain; Gomti Foods +2%, Narmada Steel −3%, Sutlej Bank +1%. Sab kuch ek hi company mein tha. Aapke simulated ₹50,000 ab lagbhag ₹32,500 hain (−₹17,500).
hinglish.states.b2_all.channel.messages.0: SOLAR SHOCK: subsidy ruki. Sector tezi se gira.
hinglish.states.b2_all.evidence.b2_conc.label: Aapka kitna paisa solar par tika tha?
hinglish.states.b2_all.evidence.b2_conc.text: Dekho ek hi ghatna se har choice ne kitna khoya.
hinglish.states.b2_all.evidence.b2_conc.why: Ek hi ghatna se nuksaan is baat par nirbhar karta hai ki paisa kitna ek jagah tha.
hinglish.states.b2_all.evidence.b2_hold.label: “Ye wapas aayega” — poore vishwas se kaha gaya
hinglish.states.b2_all.evidence.b2_hold.text: Koi bhavishya ke baare mein pakka hai.
hinglish.states.b2_all.evidence.b2_hold.why: Koi nahi jaanta. Sudhaar ka pakka vishwas utna hi bharosemand nahi jitna girne ka.
hinglish.states.b2_all.actions.review.label: Review: mera kitna paisa ek company ya sector par tika tha?
hinglish.states.b2_all.actions.review.consequence: Aap har holding aur uske vyavhaar ki list banate ho. Tasveer saaf hoti hai.
hinglish.states.b2_all.actions.double_down.label: Baaki paisa usi company mein daalo taaki jaldi wapas aaye
hinglish.states.b2_all.actions.double_down.conseq: Aap asar dekhne ke turant baad concentration badha dete ho.
hinglish.states.b2_all.actions.wait_sure.label: Kuch mat karo; ye asthayi hai, mujhe pakka pata hai
hinglish.states.b2_all.actions.wait_sure.conseque: Aap plan ki jagah pakke vishwas ke ehsaas par bharosa karte ho.
hinglish.states.b2_all.reasoning_prompt: Ye nateeja aapke chunav ke baare mein kya batata hai?

hinglish.states.b3_broad.title: Ek alag tarah ki giravat
hinglish.states.b3_broad.narrative: Kuch hafte baad poore kaalpanik market mein vyapak giravat aati hai: chaaron companies sector chahe jo ho, ek saath lagbhag 12% girti hain. Cash (agar hai) wahi rehta hai.
hinglish.states.b3_broad.evidence.b3_all.label: Alag assets ek saath gire
hinglish.states.b3_broad.evidence.b3_all.text: Is baar sector ne fark nahi daala.
hinglish.states.b3_broad.evidence.b3_all.why: Diversification concentration risk ghatata hai, par poore market ka risk rehta hai. Ye seatbelt hai, avijay kavach nahi.
hinglish.states.b3_broad.evidence.b3_claim.label: “Diversification kaam nahi karta”
hinglish.states.b3_broad.evidence.b3_claim.why: Ek ghatna jisme assets saath gire pichhli seekh ko radd nahi karti; dono baatein sach hain.
hinglish.states.b3_broad.actions.understand.label: Dono sach: baantna ek-company risk mein madad karta hai; poore market ka risk nahi hatata, isliye plan, samay-seema aur cushion zaroori
hinglish.states.b3_broad.actions.understand.conse: Aap do vichar ek saath rakhte ho, jo majboot plan ko chahiye.
To baantna bekaar hai — wapas ek company par jao
Aap ek kaam ka aujaar chhod dete ho kyunki wo jaadu nahi tha.
hinglish.states.b3_broad.actions.eliminated.label: Maine diversify kiya, to mujhe kuch nahi khona chahiye tha
hinglish.states.b3_broad.actions.eliminated.conse: Aapne socha diversification sab risk hata dega.
hinglish.states.b3_broad.reasoning_prompt: Diversification kya karta hai, aur kya nahi kar sakta?
hinglish.states.t_aware.title: Aap dono pehlu dekhte ho
hinglish.states.t_aware.narrative: Baantna kisi ek cheez ke bigadne ka nuksaan ghatata hai, par sab par asar karne wala risk nahi hata sakta. Aujaar kya karta hai — aur kya nahi — ye jaanna hi mudda hai.
hinglish.states.t_aware.outcome.headline: Aap dono pehlu dekhte ho
hinglish.states.t_aware.outcome.summary: Baantna kisi ek cheez ke bigadne ka nuksaan ghatata hai, par sab par asar karne wala risk nahi hata sakta. Aujaar kya karta hai — aur kya nahi — ye jaanna hi mudda hai.
hinglish.states.t_overreacted.title: Aujaar, jaadu nahi
hinglish.states.t_overreacted.narrative: Diversification ne pehle jhatke mein apna kaam kiya. Ek vyapak giravat use bekaar nahi banati; use akele adhoora banati hai.
hinglish.states.t_overreacted.outcome.headline: Aujaar, jaadu nahi
hinglish.states.t_overreacted.outcome.summary: Diversification ne pehle jhatke mein apna kaam kiya. Ek vyapak giravat use bekaar nahi banati; use akele adhoora banati hai.
hinglish.states.t_overconfident.title: Koi risk nahi, aisi ummeed
hinglish.states.t_overconfident.narrative: Diversification risk hatana nahi hai. Aisa maanne se log jhelne se zyada risk le sakte hain.

hinglish.states.t_doubled_down.narrative: Concentration ka asar dekhne ke turant baad usi jagah aur daalna loss-recovery ka jaal hai. Bada daanv wapas aane ka tez raasta nahi.

hinglish.states.t_doubled_down.outcome.summary: Concentration ka asar dekhne ke turant baad usi jagah aur daalna loss-recovery ka jaal hai. Bada daanv wapas aane ka tez raasta nahi.
hinglish.reflection.key_points.0: Ek company ya sector ek saath bahut gir sakta hai. Concentration risk wo hissa hai jo ek ghatna se prabhavit hota hai.
hinglish.reflection.key_points.1: Do milti-julti assets (ek hi sector) asli diversification nahi.
hinglish.reflection.key_points.2: Diversification risk ghatata hai, khatam nahi karta.
hinglish.reflection.key_points.3: Aasani se milne wale paise ka cushion majboot plan ka hissa hai.
hinglish.reflection.questions.0: Aapke paise ka kitna hissa ek cheez par tika hai?
hinglish.reflection.micro_lesson.title: 'Agar ye ek cheez fail ho gayi to?' sawaal
hinglish.reflection.micro_lesson.body: Kisi bhi plan par poochho: agar sabse bada hissa 40% gir jaye to mera kitna kul nuksaan hoga? Agar jawab jhel pane se zyada hai to plan bahut concentrated hai.
